t: The Magnusson aluminium folding work platform provides a stable and secure elevated surface for various trade tasks. Ideal for painters, decorators, and general construction work, its robust design supports a maximum static vertical load of 150kg. The 475mm high platform features an anti-slip surface and feet, ensuring safety during use. Steel lockable hinges secure the platform in position, and it folds flat for convenient transportation and compact storage in vans or workshops.
